sentences.text:
-
Heard Sri Diwakar Shukla, learned counsel for the revisionist; Sri Shivakant, learned counsel for respondent no. 2 and learned A.G.A for the State-respondent and perused the trial court record.

-
The present criminal revision is being filed challenging the impugned judgment and order dated 31.03.2023 passed by the Court of Special Judge, POCSO Act District Fatehpur in Criminal Appeal No. 45 of 2021 (Abrar Ahmad Versus Juvenile and others) whereby appeal of the first informant regarding the dispute of the Juvenility of the revisionist was allowed in the favour of the first informant and the judgment and order passed by Juvenile Justice Board, Fatehpur dated 05.08.2021 was set aside regarding Case Crime No. 566 of 2019, Under Section 363, 376 I.P.C. &
3/4 Pocso Act, Police Station- Kotwali, District- Fatehpur.

entities.text: Special Judge, POCSO Act District Fatehpur
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Abrar Ahmad Versus Juvenile and others)
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
- 
The order dated 31.03.2023 under challenge before this court has been passed by the Appellate court, Fatehpur directing the Juvenile Justice Board, Fatehpur to comply the directions earlier given by the appellate court by the order dated 18.11.2020 for determination of the correct age of an accused-revisionist, since two contradictory dates of birth were placed before the Board.

However,
disregarding the remand order dated 18.11.2020 passed by the Appellate Court, the Juvenile Justice Board illegally proceeded to declare the revisionist as a Juvenile by the order dated 05.08.2021.
Consequently, by the impugned order dated 31.03.2023, the Children's Court has again remanded the matter to the Juvenile Justice Board for consideration of the dispute in accordance with law.

-
This Court, after hearing the rival submissions, finds that the order dated 05.08.2021 passed by the Juvenile Justice Board has clearly disregarded the earlier directions contained in the order dated 18.11.2020 of the Appellate Court while determining the question of juvenility of the revisionist.

The X (Juvenile) vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114272482/
2 order of remand seems justified.

entities.text: X (Juvenile) vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others
entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text:
-
Since the issue has remained undecided since the year 2020, the Juvenile Justice Board, Fatehpur,
is directed to comply with the remand order dated 31.03.2023 passed by the Appellate Court,
Fatehpur, within a period of six weeks from the date of production of a certified copy of this order or from the date of its receipt through the Registrar (Compliance) of this Court.

-
The criminal revision is hereby dismissed.

-
The order dated 31.03.2023 passed by the Special Judge POCSO Act, Fatehpur is hereby affirmed.

-
The Registrar (Compliance) is directed to send a copy of this order to the Juvenile Justice Board,
Fatehpur, within a period of one week for compliance.

-
The Juvenile Justice Board, Fatehpur, shall submit a compliance report to this Court within one week from the date of taking a fresh decision in pursuance of the above directions, to be kept on record.

-
Let the lower court record be sent back to the trial court within a period of one week.

(Siddharth,J.) September 8, 2025 Rohit  X (Juvenile) vs State Of U.P. And 3 Others on 8 September, 2025 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/114272482/
